Introduction

Chaein is a South Korean singer, dancer and rapper under RBW. She is a member of the girl group PURPLE KISS, with whom she debuted on March 15, 2021, with the mini album “INTO VIOLET”, and its title track “Ponzona”.

Prior to her debut with the group, Chaein participated in the first and third seasons of the reality TV show "K-Pop Star".
